in_marathi.name: Ashyansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashyansh is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'ashyana' meaning 'seat' and 'ansh' meaning 'part'. The name signifies a noble and valiant being, someone who holds an important position or power.
